text:
zach: Heads up 
- proposing a compact analytics envelope change: replace freeform profile_attrs + ui_labels + long cost blobs with profile_id, labelset_id, and a 3-field cost_summary. Target ~30% reduction.

nina: Good. Critical fields for billing/routing stay inline?

zach: Yes: route_id, tenant_id, ts, tokens_generated, model_name, model_variant, cost_summary (currency, unit_rate, model_bucket) remain. raw_prompt removed except sample/eval traffic.

rahul: Backfill plan? Full rewrite risky.

zach: Dual-write for 2 weeks: v2 compact envelope written alongside legacy v1. Read layer will support both; default to v2. Targeted backfill for hot routes only (top 5%). Pseudo SQL to populate profiles:
```
INSERT INTO profiles (profile_hash, attrs)
SELECT sha256(profile_attrs::text), profile_attrs
FROM events
WHERE profile_attrs IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY profile_attrs
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
```

kevin: Monitoring & canary?

zach: Canary ingest v2 @20% with golden-query diffs (top-40 dashboards). Alerts: diff >0.5%, ingest 5xx spike, profile-miss-rate >3%. Add feature flag ingest_compact and admin kill-switch.

ingest-bot: canary-deploy: ingest-service:v2 started on cluster-us-central-1 (20%).

nina: I'll draft migration docs and a console query compatibility guide.

rahul: I'll own backfill jobs and profile/labelset schema. Schedule backfills off-peak.

kevin: I'll implement console read-adapter, cache profile payloads in service to avoid join hotpaths.

zach: Timeline: day0 RFC+PR; day2 canary 20%; day5 dual-write 100%; day8 targeted backfill; day12 dashboard shim rollout; day30 review. Any blockers?

kevin: none from infra. keep monitoring tight.

ingest-bot: canary-deploy: ingest-service:v2 canary increased to 50% traffic.
